## What is it?
The Research Administrations Platform (RAP) enables researchers and support teams to work in a smart way by providing a simple, unified, intuitive and reliable platform that supports the administrative formalities of the research lifecycle at VU.  

The objective is to reduce the administrative burden for researchers and support teams by streamlining research workflows. It ensures that forms can be reused across processes minimizing duplication of information. It provides guidance to researchers and support staff tailored per faculty and school. 
## What can it be used for?
RAP supports and integrates key research forms (DMP and Ethics) in one place.

### Data Management Plan
RAP can be used to create a DMP.

### Ethics
RAP can be used to prepare for an Ethical Review.

### Support interaction
RAP provides user friendly support options for the researcher, strengthening the collaboration between the researcher and the support teams.
